scope: Actual owned Glue Python-shell -> S3 -> Glue catalog -> Athena SQL -> consumed S3 result bytes, plus cancellation; not full service conformance

observed: Real producer success and deliberate runtime failure
Catalog-backed aggregation of actual S3 bytes
Enforced workgroup output overrides client output; field removal and disabled workgroup behavior
Idempotent token identity including table-denied reader; mismatched token rejection
Header counted in MaxResults, continuation after final data row and final empty page
Prepared-statement duplicate/missing/update semantics and workgroup scope
Missing Glue metadata translates to Athena MetadataException
Athena API deny leaves independent S3 access usable; current S3 deny blocks Athena result access
Column failure category 2/type 1006 and actual native event fields
Stop after already-completed query succeeds and retains SUCCEEDED; not evidence of active cancellation
Signed AWS JSON1.1 submit/immediate stop reaches CANCELLED
cancellation_verified.json.bounds: Generated scalar SQL only, no customer-data scan; 10MiB scan cutoff; immediate stop; 60s terminal polling bound; maximum 100,000,000 generated join pairs if cancellation races

s3_transport.json.observed: Actual byte-for-byte PutObject/GetObject consumer using AWS CLI custom GetObject without unsupported --cli-input-json
s3_transport.json.note: Immediate HeadBucket briefly succeeded after successful DeleteBucket. Later exact-name HeadBucket returned 404; both observations retained.

runtime_replay_requirement: testdata/aws/glue/producer.py is the actual native Python-shell specimen. The local runtime must isolate/route its botocore S3 client to the emulator; native Glue shell botocore 1.23 does not implement modern AWS_ENDPOINT_URL environment support. Never permit an ambient AWS fallback.
verification_exercised: Both Athena fixture-consumer modes executed against canonical native captures. No local emulator replay or project build/test/lint/formatting executed by this owner.

preserved_failed_captures.application.json: CLI transport/setup failure before any job; prior owned bucket cleanup proven in application_cleanup.json. Initial PutObject Body JSON was a literal path string, not customer input bytes; not data-plane proof.
preserved_failed_captures.application_cleanup.json: Exact prior bucket objects deleted and HeadBucket returned 404.
preserved_failed_captures.application_complete.json: Real producer SUCCEEDED, immediate next StartJobRun rejected due to concurrency-slot release lag. No Athena query reached. Cleanup verified.
preserved_failed_captures.application_s3.json: Real producer SUCCEEDED; custom GetObject required explicit --bucket/--key flags. CLI ParamValidation retained; cleanup verified.
preserved_failed_captures.application_native.json: Real producer SUCCEEDED; custom GetObject does not accept --cli-input-json. CLI error retained; cleanup verified.
preserved_failed_captures.cancellation.json: Shared JSON1.0 observer could not parse Athena response; protocol corrected to modeled JSON1.1 in cancellation_verified.json. Original HTTP status/body unavailable from that failed decoder. Owned workgroup/bucket cleanup verified.

event_observations.glue_catalog_resources: CreateDatabase used database ARN; CreateTable used table ARN, not the anomalous database/table form in a documentation example.
event_observations.athena_states: QUEUED omits previousState; RUNNING follows QUEUED; SUCCEEDED/FAILED follows RUNNING; sequenceNumber is a string. FAILED adds athenaError.
event_observations.delivery_boundary: Actual order and timestamps preserved; no guaranteed ordering/completeness/timing claim. Queue receipt handles excluded before persistence.

campaign_bounds_and_cost.billing_note: Cost figures are planning estimates, not observed billing. Sources https://aws.amazon.com/glue/pricing/ ($0.44/DPU-hour), https://aws.amazon.com/athena/pricing/ ($5/TB), and Python-shell 0.0625-DPU documentation. Actual job execution times and scanned bytes are retained. API/local CLI validation failures count as recorded calls, not necessarily billable AWS requests.

remaining_boundaries: No paid Spark, CTAS/UNLOAD/federated data source or complete SQL compatibility claim
No native runtime log delivery proof: job role had no default log-group modification permissions
Glue Python-shell metrics discovery returned empty in exact scoped reads; no fabricated metric emission

Deleted native query/job history is service-retained and has no purge API; all observed executions reached terminal states and their owned workgroups/jobs/storage were deleted.
